sentences.text: Every answer an AI gives you is built from tokens, and every token starts as energy.
At Texas Tech University, a supercomputer called REPACSS takes much of its energy straight from the sun.
It lives at GLEAMM, a microgrid lab on the West Texas plains, beside a 350 kilowatt solar array.
When clouds roll over, a battery, the power grid, and a diesel generator step in.
Sunlight frees electrons in silicon, and those electrons flow into the cluster.
There, thousands of processor cores and powerful GPUs turn electricity into science, and into tokens.
In Photon Dash, you are that photon. Fly from the sun to a token, and see how far your energy takes you.
